description: Search anime or manga by title, genre, tag, season, year, format, or status. Needs at least one criterion — a sort other than SEARCH_MATCH alone browses the whole catalog. Returns ranked results with AniList IDs, titles, scores, format, and episode/chapter counts. When AniList has no match for a title-only query, falls back to MyAnimeList (via Jikan) and maps its rows to AniList IDs.

format.description: Format filter; exact blank counts as absent.

genre.description: Genre filter, e.g. "Action", "Romance", "Slice of Life", "Mecha". Trimmed; blank counts as absent.

include_adult.description: Include adult/NSFW content, including in MyAnimeList fallback results. Default false.

media_type.description: Media type to search: anime or manga.

page.description: 1-based page number. AniList serves only the first 5,000 results, so page × per_page must stay at or below 5,000.

per_page.description: Results per page. Maximum 50; page × per_page must stay at or below 5,000. The MyAnimeList fallback runs only at 25 or fewer.

query.description: Title search query. Supports partial matches. Trimmed; blank counts as absent.

anyOf.description: Anime broadcast season. WINTER=Jan–Mar, SPRING=Apr–Jun, SUMMER=Jul–Sep, FALL=Oct–Dec.

season.description: Broadcast season filter; exact blank counts as absent.

season_year.description: 4-digit year of the broadcast season, e.g. 2024. Without it, season matches that season in every year.

sort.description: Sort order list. Default: SEARCH_MATCH (title relevance) when query is set, otherwise POPULARITY_DESC. SEARCH_MATCH ranks only against a query.

items.description: Sort field; exact blank items are dropped.

status.description: Production status filter; exact blank counts as absent.

tag.description: AniList tag filter, e.g. "Isekai", "School", "Time Manipulation". Genres such as "Action" are not tags. Trimmed; blank counts as absent.

name: anime_search_media

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `missing_criteria`: No search criterion remains after blank query, genre, and tag values are dropped. `page_depth_exceeded`: page × per_page reaches past the first 5,000 results, which AniList refuses to serve. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_next_page.description: Whether more pages are available. Drives pagination; stop when false.

notice.description: Set when results is empty: echoes the applied criteria and how to broaden them, says when the page is past the end of the results, and says when the MyAnimeList fallback was skipped or could not be checked. Also set on the last page AniList serves (its 5,000-entry reach) while has_next_page is still true.

format.description: Format: TV, MOVIE, OVA, ONA, MANGA, NOVEL, etc.

id.description: AniList media ID. Use with anime_get_media for full detail.

id_mal.description: MyAnimeList ID, or null if unavailable.

is_adult.description: Whether this entry is marked adult/NSFW.

mean_score.description: AniList mean score 0–100, or null. Use anime_get_media for MAL score too.

title_native.description: Native script title (Japanese, Korean, etc.), or null.

source.description: Which API provided these results: "anilist" (primary) or "jikan" (MyAnimeList fallback for a title-only query AniList has no match for).

totalCount.description: Exact number of matching results, set only on the final AniList page (0 for an empty first page). Use has_next_page to paginate.

total_results.description: Exact number of matching results, present only on the final AniList page (has_next_page false) and 0 for an empty first page. Null on every other page and on MyAnimeList-sourced pages.

title: Anime Search Media
